# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_009_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 9

**9:1** Joseph put down his carpenter's tools and joined the line. All the widowers filed in to see the high priest, each man gripping his staff. The priest collected them all and went alone into the temple to pray. When he came back out, he returned the staffs one by one. Nothing happened. No sign, no wonder — just a roomful of men holding plain wooden sticks.

**9:2** Joseph was last. When the priest handed him his staff, a dove burst out of it and flew up onto Joseph's head. The priest said: "Joseph! You are the one. God has chosen you to take the Lord's virgin into your household."

**9:3** Joseph shook his head. "No — I have grown sons already. I'm an old man. She's a young girl. The people will laugh at me."

**9:4** The priest leaned in close. "Joseph, you need to fear God. Remember what happened to Dathan and Abiram and Korah — the earth opened up and swallowed them whole because they defied God's command. Do you want the same thing to happen to your family?"

**9:5** That settled it. Joseph took Mary and brought her home. He told her: "Mary, I've taken you from the temple. I'm leaving you here in the house while I go to work on my building sites — I'll be back. The Lord will look after you."
